shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat vertical/horizontal stone surface
repeated row of similar figures in profile
band of repeated ornament (rosettes / arcaded row)
justification: Both are low-relief stone surfaces organised into horizontal registers with a repeated row of similar figures along the top and a decorative band beneath, which is the most specific correspondence. But the depicted content differs almost entirely: A shows naturalistic robed human figures in procession carrying vessels, facing a seated/standing figure, with a rosette frieze, while B shows highly schematic animals (a quadruped, a crouching creature, a large bird with wing) and abstract signs with no human procession or vessel-bearing.
